description: This Java class 'DeliveryInd' represents an MMS Delivery Indication (DeliveryInd PDU) in the Android MMS library. It defines methods to construct, access, and modify delivery indication message data such as date, message ID, status, and recipients.

classes.name: DeliveryInd
classes.description: Represents an MMS Delivery Indication (DeliveryInd PDU) with methods to access and modify message properties.

methods.name: DeliveryInd
methods.description: Default constructor, intended for instantiation by the PDU parser, sets message type to DELIVERY_IND.

methods.name: DeliveryInd(PduHeaders headers)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the DeliveryInd with specified headers.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date of the delivery indication message.

methods.name: setDate
methods.description: Sets the date of the delivery indication message.

methods.name: getMessageId
methods.description: Returns the message ID associated with the delivery report.

methods.name: setMessageId
methods.description: Sets the message ID for the delivery report.

methods.name: setStatus
methods.description: Sets the delivery status, throws exception if invalid.

methods.name: getTo
methods.description: Returns the recipient(s) of the delivery report.

methods.name: setTo
methods.description: Sets the recipient(s) of the delivery report.
